money: This work was financed by national funds from FCT—Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia, I.P., in the scope of the project UIDP/04378/2020 and UIDB/04378/2020 of the Research Unit on Applied Molecular Biosciences-UCIBIO, and the project LA/P/0140/2020 of the Associate Laboratory Institute for Health and Bioeconomy-i4HB. design.quote: In this manuscript, we evaluate the survival, developmental, and reproductive impact of these designer drugs on the model organism Caenorhabditis elegans (C. elegans).
design.text: evaluating the survival, developmental, and reproductive impact of 2C-I and 25I-NBOMe on the model organism Caenorhabditis elegans

findings.quote: A concentration-dependent decrease in animal survival was observed. 25I-NBOMe was approximately six times more toxic than 2C-I (LC50 values—1.368 mM for 2C-I and 0.236 mM for 25I-NBOMe).
findings.text: A concentration-dependent decrease in animal survival was observed, with 25I-NBOMe being approximately six times more toxic than 2C-I, showing LC50 values of 1.368 mM for 2C-I and 0.236 mM for 25I-NBOMe.

findings.quote: For both drugs, we observed clear signs of mitochondrial dysfunction, including increased intracellular Ca2⁺ levels (only 25I-NBOMe), decreased intracellular ATP levels, and mitochondrial membrane depolarization, though there were no significant changes in intracellular ROS levels.
findings.text: For both drugs, clear signs of mitochondrial dysfunction were observed, including increased intracellular Ca2⁺ levels (only 25I-NBOMe), decreased intracellular ATP levels, and mitochondrial membrane depolarization, though there were no significant changes in intracellular ROS levels.

findings.quote: Additionally, both substances induced apoptosis, but interestingly, only 2C-I was found to induce autophagy and strongly trigger caspase-3 activation.
findings.text: Additionally, both substances induced apoptosis, but only 2C-I was found to induce autophagy and strongly trigger caspase-3 activation.

limits.quote: However, to date, there are no in vivo studies assessing the impact of 2C-I and 25I-NBOMe on development and reproductive behavior, which is vital for understanding their broader biological effects and potential risks.
limits.text: To date, there are no in vivo studies assessing the impact of 2C-I and 25I-NBOMe on development and reproductive behavior prior to this work.

money: National Institutes of Health, United States

design.quote: A parallel series of several N-benzylated analogues of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodophenethylamine (2C-I) also was included for comparison of the two major templates (i.e., tryptamine and phenethylamine).
design.text: laboratory study preparing, investigating, and comparing N-benzylated-5-methoxytryptamine analogues and N-benzylated analogues of 2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodophenethylamine (2C-I)

findings.quote: Effects can include: seeing and hearing things that aren’t there; mood changes which can include relaxation or agitation; euphoria; increased appreciation for music; enhanced sense of touch; confusion; sweating; short term memory problems; high blood pressure; fast heartbeat; high body temperature; panic and paranoia.
findings.text: Effects of NBOMes can include seeing and hearing things that are not there, mood changes such as relaxation or agitation, euphoria, increased appreciation for music, enhanced sense of touch, confusion, sweating, short-term memory problems, high blood pressure, fast heartbeat, high body temperature, and panic and paranoia.

findings.quote: A ‘bad trip’ usually includes anxiety, paranoia, panic, or other negative emotions. People can also experience unpleasant or intense hallucinations.
findings.text: A bad trip usually involves anxiety, paranoia, panic, or other negative emotions, alongside unpleasant or intense hallucinations.

findings.quote: Symptoms of overdose may include: intense confusion; severe agitation; seizure; kidney failure; nausea and vomiting; rapid heart rate; rapid or difficulty breathing; overheating; attempted suicide; coma.
findings.text: Symptoms of an NBOMe overdose may include intense confusion, severe agitation, seizure, kidney failure, nausea and vomiting, rapid heart rate, rapid or difficulty breathing, overheating, attempted suicide, and coma.
